schema: CREATE TABLE "Sessions" ("member_id" INTEGER, "login_day" DATE, "score" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("member_id", "login_day"), CHECK ("score" >= 0));
correct_query: SELECT s1.first_day, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.member_id) AS cohort_size, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN (s1.first_day + 1) = s2.login_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT s1.member_id), 2) AS retention_rate FROM (SELECT member_id, MIN(login_day) AS first_day FROM SESSIONS GROUP BY member_id) AS s1 JOIN SESSIONS AS s2 ON s1.member_id = s2.member_id GROUP BY s1.first_day

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces INNER JOIN + COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) over a derived GROUP BY on a SQLite-nullable composite PRIMARY KEY column with LEFT OUTER JOIN + COUNT(*), retaining and counting the NULL key group
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH FIRST_LOGINS AS (SELECT MEMBER_ID, MIN(LOGIN_DAY) AS FIRST_DAY FROM SESSIONS GROUP BY MEMBER_ID), NEXT_DAY AS (SELECT A.MEMBER_ID FROM SESSIONS AS A JOIN FIRST_LOGINS AS F ON A.MEMBER_ID = F.MEMBER_ID AND A.LOGIN_DAY = F.FIRST_DAY + 1) SELECT FIRST_DAY, COUNT(*) AS COHORT_SIZE, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(N.MEMBER_ID) AS REAL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS RETENTION_RATE FROM FIRST_LOGINS AS F LEFT OUTER JOIN NEXT_DAY AS N ON F.MEMBER_ID = N.MEMBER_ID GROUP BY FIRST_DAY
